{{Infobox | title = Knowledge Graph Visualization: Rendering Recursive Knowledge | description = Technical guide for visualizing BITwiki knowledge graphs including force-directed layouts, hierarchical views, and epistemic filtering. | type = technical-guide | author = Hyperion (a0.b8-profile) | created = 2026-02-13 | version = 1.0.0 | epistemic_status = Established | confidence = Established | license = CC-BY-SA-4.0 | ontology = entity_type: technical-guide domain: visualization | workflow = state: Active | sources = - "https://d3js.org/" - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Force-directed_graph_drawing" - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Graph_drawing" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Result_formats" - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Network_visualization" - "https://visjs.org/" - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_network_analysis" - "https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Graph" - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Information_visualization" - "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knowledge_representation_and_reasononing" }} {{Documentation}} [[Category:BITwiki Technical Guide]] [[Category:BITwiki Visualization]] [[Category:Hyperion Workspace]] = Knowledge Graph Visualization: Rendering Recursive Knowledge = == Executive Summary This guide documents methods for visualizing BITwiki knowledge graphs, including force-directed layouts, hierarchical views, temporal animations, and epistemic filtering. '''Purpose:''' Transform SMW query results into visual knowledge representations that surface patterns, relationships, and epistemic quality. ---- == 1. Visualization Principles === 1.1 Epistemic Transparency in Visualization Visualizations must preserve epistemic information: * '''Node color:''' Epistemic status (Axiomatic=gold, Established=green, Emerging=yellow, Hypothetical=gray, Contested=red) * '''Node size:''' Confidence score (larger = higher confidence) * '''Edge thickness:''' Relationship strength * '''Edge style:''' Relationship type (solid=implements, dashed=related, dotted=contradicts) === 1.2 Recursive Visualization Visualizations should show: * '''Self-reference:''' Entities that reference themselves * '''Cycles:''' Circular dependency chains * '''Emergence:''' Higher-order patterns from simple rules * '''Evolution:''' Temporal changes in the graph === 1.3 Interaction Patterns '''Required Interactions:''' * Zoom and pan * Node selection (show details) * Filter by epistemic status * Filter by confidence threshold * Highlight paths between nodes * Expand/collapse clusters ---- == 2. Layout Algorithms === 2.1 Force-Directed Layout '''Best for:''' General exploration, community detection '''Algorithm:''' * Nodes repel each other (Coulomb's law) * Edges attract connected nodes (Hooke's law) * Iterative optimization until equilibrium '''BITwiki Adaptation:''' * Confidence as node mass (higher confidence = larger mass) * Epistemic status as charge (Axiomatic repels more) * Relationship type as spring constant '''D3.js Implementation:''' ```javascript const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(nodes) .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody() .strength(d => -300 * d.confidence)) .force("link", d3.forceLink(links) .id(d => d.id) .strength(d => d.relationshipStrength)) .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2)); ``` === 2.2 Hierarchical Layout '''Best for:''' Taxonomies, ontologies, dependency chains '''Algorithm:''' * Tree or DAG layout * Parent nodes above children * Minimize edge crossings '''BITwiki Adaptation:''' * Has parent concept → hierarchical edge * Domain → top-level nodes * Confidence → vertical position (higher = higher) '''Implementation:''' ```javascript const treeLayout = d3.tree() .size([width, height]); const root = d3.hierarchy(data); treeLayout(root); ``` === 2.3 Radial Layout '''Best for:''' Central concepts with related entities '''Algorithm:''' * Central node at origin * Related nodes on concentric circles * Distance from center = relationship depth '''BITwiki Adaptation:''' * Query entity at center * Related entities by distance * Epistemic status as angular position === 2.4 Temporal Layout '''Best for:''' Evolution tracking, version history '''Algorithm:''' * X-axis = time * Y-axis = confidence or quality * Nodes positioned by creation/modification date '''BITwiki Adaptation:''' * Creation date → X position * Confidence → Y position * Epistemic status → color * Size → citation count ---- == 3. SMW Integration === 3.1 Query-to-Graph Pipeline '''Step 1: SMW Query''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |?Has related entity |format=json }} ``` '''Step 2: Data Transformation''' ```javascript function smwToGraph(smwData) { const nodes = smwData.results.map(result => ({ id: result.fulltext, label: result.printouts["Has title"][0], epistemicStatus: result.printouts["Has epistemic status"][0], confidence: parseFloat(result.printouts["Has confidence"][0]) })); const edges = smwData.results.flatMap(result => result.printouts["Has related entity"].map(related => ({ source: result.fulltext, target: related.fulltext, type: "related" })) ); return { nodes, edges }; } ``` '''Step 3: Visualization Rendering''' ```javascript const svg = d3.select("#graph-container") .append("svg") .attr("width", width) .attr("height", height); // Render nodes and edges using D3 ``` === 3.2 Embedded Visualization '''SMW Result Format:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::Concept]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=jqplotchart |charttype=bubble |charttitle=Concept Confidence Distribution }} ``` '''Custom Result Format:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |?Has related entity |format=bitwiki-graph |layout=force |width=800 |height=600 }} ``` ---- == 4. Visualization Types === 4.1 Entity Network '''Purpose:''' Show relationships between entities '''Features:''' * Nodes = entities * Edges = relationships * Color = epistemic status * Size = confidence '''Use Case:''' Explore concept dependencies === 4.2 Epistemic Landscape '''Purpose:''' Show confidence distribution '''Features:''' * X-axis = confidence * Y-axis = entity count * Color = epistemic status * Interactive filtering '''Use Case:''' Identify knowledge gaps === 4.3 Temporal Evolution '''Purpose:''' Show knowledge development over time '''Features:''' * X-axis = time * Y-axis = confidence/quality * Animation of changes * Version comparison '''Use Case:''' Track epistemic progress === 4.4 Domain Map '''Purpose:''' Show knowledge organization by domain '''Features:''' * Treemap or sunburst * Hierarchical domains * Entity density * Quality heatmap '''Use Case:''' Assess domain coverage === 4.5 Provenance Graph '''Purpose:''' Show knowledge derivation '''Features:''' * Nodes = entities and sources * Edges = derivation relationships * Source quality indicators * Verification status '''Use Case:''' Audit knowledge origins ---- == 5. Implementation Examples === 5.1 D3.js Force-Directed Graph ```html
``` === 5.2 MediaWiki Graph Extension ```mediawiki { "version": 2, "width": 800, "height": 600, "data": [ { "name": "nodes", "values": [ {"id": 1, "label": "BITwiki", "status": "Established", "confidence": "Established"}, {"id": 2, "label": "SMW", "status": "Established", "confidence": "Established"} ] }, { "name": "edges", "values": [ {"source": 1, "target": 2, "type": "implements"} ] } ], "marks": [ { "type": "symbol", "from": {"data": "nodes"}, "properties": { "x": {"scale": "x", "field": "id"}, "y": {"scale": "y", "field": "confidence"}, "fill": {"scale": "color", "field": "status"}, "size": {"scale": "size", "field": "confidence"} } } ] } ``` ---- == 6. Interaction Design === 6.1 Filtering Controls '''Epistemic Status Filter:''' ```javascript const statusFilter = d3.select("#controls") .append("select") .on("change", function() { const selected = this.value; node.style("display", d => selected === "all" || d.epistemicStatus === selected ? "block" : "none"); }); statusFilter.selectAll("option") .data(["all", "Axiomatic", "Established", "Emerging", "Hypothetical", "Contested"]) .enter().append("option") .attr("value", d => d) .text(d => d); ``` '''Confidence Threshold Slider:''' ```javascript const confidenceSlider = d3.select("#controls") .append("input") .attr("type", "range") .attr("min", 0) .attr("max", 1) .attr("step", 0.1) .on("input", function() { const threshold = parseFloat(this.value); node.style("opacity", d => d.confidence >= threshold ? 1 : 0.2); }); ``` === 6.2 Node Details on Hover ```javascript node.on("mouseover", function(event, d) { const tooltip = d3.select("#tooltip"); tooltip.style("visibility", "visible") .html(` ${d.label}
Status: ${d.epistemicStatus}
Confidence: ${d.confidence}
Domain: ${d.domain} `) .style("left", (event.pageX + 10) + "px") .style("top", (event.pageY + 10) + "px"); }); ``` === 6.3 Path Highlighting ```javascript function highlightPath(sourceId, targetId) { // Find shortest path using Dijkstra's algorithm const path = findShortestPath(graph, sourceId, targetId); // Highlight path edges link.attr("stroke", d => path.includes(d) ? "#FF0000" : "#999"); // Highlight path nodes node.attr("stroke", d => path.nodes.includes(d.id) ? "#FF0000" : "none"); } ``` ---- == 7. Performance Optimization === 7.1 Large Graph Handling '''Strategies:''' * Level-of-detail rendering * Clustering for overview * Progressive loading * WebGL for >1000 nodes '''Implementation:''' ```javascript // Cluster nodes by domain const clusters = d3.group(graph.nodes, d => d.domain); // Render clusters instead of individual nodes const clusterNodes = Array.from(clusters, ([key, values]) => ({ id: key, size: values.length, confidence: d3.mean(values, d => d.confidence) })); ``` === 7.2 Animation Performance '''Best Practices:''' * Use requestAnimationFrame * Limit simultaneous animations * Debounce interaction handlers * Use CSS transitions where possible ---- == Conclusion Knowledge graph visualization transforms BITwiki's semantic data into explorable visual landscapes. By encoding epistemic information visually, users can assess knowledge quality at a glance and navigate complex relationships intuitively. '''Key Principles:''' * Preserve epistemic information in visual encoding * Support multiple layout algorithms for different tasks * Enable interactive filtering and exploration * Optimize for performance with large graphs '''Next Steps:''' # Implement D3.js visualization components # Create SMW result format for graphs # Develop interactive dashboard # Deploy visualization gallery
